hints.title: Maintain Current Depth
hints.text: Simulate directory changes by tracking an integer representing folder depth from root.

hints.title: Parent Directory Boundary
hints.text: Moving up cannot decrease depth below zero.

hints.title: Current Directory No-Op
hints.text: Dotslash operations leave depth unchanged while named folder operations increment depth.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: n is number of log operations
complexity.whyNaiveFails: An explicit string array or full path string uses extra memory when only depth is needed.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: An integer counter provides O(1) auxiliary space simulation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should note that depth cannot drop below zero upon multiple parent directory calls.
